transparency.title: AI System Disclosure
transparency.body: voice-assistant is an AI system. It uses external LLM providers (configurable). Your inputs (text/voice) are sent to the chosen provider. Tool actions (file ops, email, web, WhatsApp) execute locally with your authorisation.
onboarding.slide1.title: Welcome to voice-assistant
onboarding.slide1.body: Press ⌘/Ctrl+, to open Settings any time. Press the hotkey or click the mic to talk.
onboarding.slide2.title: The orb
onboarding.slide2.body: The orb shows four states: idle (dim), listening (pulsing), thinking (spinning), and speaking (glowing). Watch it to know what the assistant is doing.
onboarding.slide3.title: Built-in tools
onboarding.slide3.body: voice-assistant can manage files, send email, search the web, open apps and URLs, send WhatsApp messages, and remember facts for you.
onboarding.slide4.title: Privacy
onboarding.slide4.body: Your conversations stay on your machine except for LLM API calls. Encryption is opt-in in Settings → Privacy.
